title: R6E exact-message and small-graph BP marginal gate

program_alignment.central_question: Can the exact nonnegative R6D likelihood graph support a practical BP approximation to the conditioned D4 posterior?
program_alignment.epistemic_role: algorithm implementation and exact small-system falsification gate
program_alignment.upstream_evidence: R6D proves the local nonnegative factor identity but does not test BP fixed points
program_alignment.downstream_gate: no correction or LER sampling until message arithmetic, convergence, and small-graph marginal bias are measured

question.research_question: Do exact sum-product factor messages recover exact marginals on factor trees, and what convergence and marginal error arise on the smallest loopy D4 graphs?
question.smallest_claim: Message implementation correctness on trees and descriptive finite-graph convergence/error on registered loopy controls only.
question.H1: both schedules reproduce exact tree marginals within 1e-10
question.H2: loopy D4 BP converges and reproduces exact physical-edge marginals within 1e-8
question.H3: loopy D4 BP converges but has nonzero fixed-point marginal bias
question.H4: one or both schedules fail to converge within the registered cap
question.falsification: any tree error above tolerance rejects the implementation; loopy error or nonconvergence rejects exact-posterior promotion but remains valid algorithmic evidence

synthetic_controls: one fixed positive binary factor tree with brute-force exact marginals
one fixed binary single-cycle factor graph with brute-force exact marginals
matrix.d4_controls: four deterministic primitive observations selected before BP by candidate-count strata: minimum multi-candidate, lower median, upper median, and maximum; p in {0.10,0.30}
d4_graph_modes: local_only: exact R6D nonnegative factors, including winding candidates in the local likelihood target
terminal_screened: the same graph plus the finite primitive global projector that zeros the 123 registered terminal-winding masks
matrix.exact_targets: brute-force all assignments for synthetic graphs; enumerate all 4096 physical masks and analytically contract auxiliary flows for primitive D4
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; zero correction, LER, threshold, or performance samples

primary_metrics: maximum and mean physical-edge marginal absolute error
analysis.branch_logic: tree failure blocks all downstream BP; loopy bias or nonconvergence is reported and routes to approximation/schedule work rather than being repaired by interpretation
analysis.terminal_logic: compare local-only and terminal-screened modes so the separate winding gate is not silently omitted

acceptance_items.item: generic exact table-message engine and R6D factor builder
acceptance_items.evidence: scripts/d4_local_bp.py and scripts/test_d4_local_bp.py; both schedules reproduce exact factor-tree marginals

acceptance_items.item: tree, single-cycle, and primitive D4 exact-marginal matrix
acceptance_items.evidence: results/r6e-bp-marginal-gate.json; tree maximum error 2.853e-11, single-cycle bias 1.277e-2, primitive raw convergence 0/16, damped convergence 10/16, exact-within-1e-8 0/32

acceptance_items.item: analysis, tests, report, and roadmap update
acceptance_items.evidence: results/r6e-bp-marginal-gate.md; Plan, Report, Wiki roadmap, Lab metadata, and index updated; 12/12 focused tests, 143/143 full-Lab tests, Wiki lint, and 16/16 dashboard tests pass

claim_boundary: R6E cannot establish scalable convergence, decoding quality, a polynomial-time decoder, logical performance, threshold, or fault tolerance.
